lines.note: COLD OPEN, CU at ground level: Sam crouched, nose almost in the dirt, eyes huge. Each 'grow' louder.

lines.text: Sam... why are you yelling at dirt?
lines.note: WS reveal: a tiny mound in a big empty yard. Layla walks in from the right and stops.

lines.text: I'm not yelling. I'm *motivating* a tree.
lines.note: He does not look away from the mound.
The gap holds the 1.8 s title sting (SAM & LAYLA / Episode 1: Grow Faster!).
Stands up, chest out.

lines.text: How much time? An hour? Two hours?
lines.note: raise1 on 'An hour?', raise2 (V) on 'Two hours?' — the «حوار» counting beat.
MCU Layla, flat. Then CU Sam frozen; crickets for ~1.4 s.
SMASH CUT, WS: Sam holds a bucket bigger than himself. Anticipation (lean back), heave on 'maximum', the splash arcs over the mound and drenches Layla.
MCU Layla dripping: drips fall from her hijab and hands, darker wet colour for ~4 s.

lines.text: Listen, little buddy. You are strong. You are tall. You are... a *tree!*
lines.note: Kneels like a coach; inspirational swell builds under the line, then a record scratch -> WS: nothing happened; crickets.

lines.text: How... to grow... a tree... fast.
lines.note: MCU, phone in hand, screen glow on his face; he reads aloud while typing (taps on each word).
A speech bubble with one filled star and four empty ones pops on 'One star!'.
CU Sam, smug, finger up.

lines.text: Fine. I'll sit right here... and *watch* it.
lines.note: WS: stomps to the rock, sits (CMU 13_01, the «حوار» sit), arms crossed, staring at the mound.

lines.text: You know... a watched pot never boils.
lines.note: The gap holds the '5 minutes later...' card (1.6 s) and a CU of Sam's twitching eye (1 s).

lines.text: That's for pots, Layla. Trees are totally different. Trees are—
lines.note: WS: he turns to Layla, his BACK to the mound. Behind him (audience only) the sprout POPS up on 'different'. Layla's eyes widen — her first non-deadpan face.
He whips round: the sprout freezes (tiny innocent wiggle). Silent gag in the next gap: he squints, turns back to Layla -> it grows (whoosh); whips round -> frozen again.
MCU Layla points AWAY from the tree (off-screen right): she is helping the tree.
WS: he looks away; behind him the tree BOOMS into a full apple tree (~1.2 s); an apple drops and BONKS his head (anchored shake).
MS: dazed, holding the apple, little stars orbiting his head, looks up at the tree.
Jumps for joy.

lines.text: Told you. It just needed time.
lines.note: MCU Layla: her first smile (the character payoff).
CU, hopeful smile.
Callback to l8. Then WS: Sam faints backwards stiff as a board, THUD + dust; iris closes on his twitching foot; sting; end card (6 s, room for YouTube end-screen elements).
